mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may potentiate the hemolytic effects of primaquine, particularly in patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency, through additive oxidative stress on red blood cells.
action: Monitor for signs of hemolysis (jaundice, dark urine, fatigue) in patients taking both agents; G6PD screening is recommended before primaquine use; consider alternative antimalarial if concurrent use is necessary.
